title: Smallest substring covering required characters
summary: A search feature must find the shortest excerpt containing every required character, including repeated characters. Given a source string and a target string, return the shortest qualifying contiguous substring, or an empty string if none exists. When several answers have the same length, return the one that appears first.
requirements: Return the empty string when no window exists or target is empty.
If equally short windows exist, use the earliest one.
hints: Keep character counts for the target, including repeated letters.
Expand right until valid, then shrink left while still valid.
